data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'r-b-y', which means to give or bestow. Jarubaa signifies a gentle, kind, and generous soul who is always willing to help others. The name Jarubaa carries the meaning “Gentle, kind, generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jarubaa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
